d:
A massive anthropomorphic walrus with thick, slate-grey skin and two prominent ivory tusks protruding from the snout. The build is bulky and rotund, wearing a deep-crimson sleeveless tunic and a matching red cape. Small, rounded ears sit atop the head, and the short, stubby tail is the same slate-grey as the body. Four thick fingers with blunt claws on each hand.
BODY COLOR: slate-grey
